notes: MPZP §6/§26: outside zone A every roof must lie between 18 m and 25 m above ground (no low pavilions!); inside zone A (≈1,180 m² within the plot) 35–45 m → the Sejmik tower must sit in the NE quadrant at the bridgehead, not on the Mazowiecka corner.

No vehicle access from the bridgehead street (1KDG): garage ramp & deliveries from Wybrzeże Słowackiego (6KDB/2) or Mazowiecka south; parking ≥12 spaces / 1000 m² of usable office area, all on our plot (underground).

No technical equipment on roofs or on street/boulevard façades → integrated technical floor + BIPV as roofing; 'special architectural requirements' and 'exposure' toward bridge, Mazowiecka and boulevard are binding.
1934 city plan overlay: the historic block had a curved frontage following the bridge ramp; today's plot line is set back — the public square on plot 9/2 becomes the civic forecourt.
Fire strategy (high-rise 'W', ZL III offices, ZL I Sejmik hall) drafted; visual-craft & board-layout methodologies written.
